title: Bound timed input support for serial MOVE fusions (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN (0% κ change).** The comparable witness is #7161 at κ = 0.003644890067940. At the fixed target 0.0040075385047236 this proof excludes 1,105 of 3,925 contiguous serial MOVE blocks. It preserves the original normalized read at its literal clock and chart, while granting arbitrary coframed scalar changes, free caches and restoration, and every compatible hypothetical fused arc at every clock. The 1,024-read cap leaves 760 reads unvisited and a positive optimistic upper of about +70.73831217726558, down from +127.33653408096442.

## Task and overlap

Changed selected-packing scope at canonical e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Exact #7161 e3f8d39c43b07063dfc5b800f71c5d21015259e6, #7113 07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d and the #7165 normalized replay are pinned. This uses a chart-level time-ordered input support bound to preserve live reads. [Clear1nsight’s same-head carrier and final-basis work](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19537073), #7003 contact slides and #5376 fixed two-hop retiming are adjacent. The exact shared event coverage of the same-head work is unverified.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-serial-temporal-support-bound
```

CPython 3.12.14. The registered check authenticates the complete signed invoice and reproduces the temporal screen, the one-read cap, the original-MOVE predecessor, and the three alternative paid deliveries that fail at role 738. Clean independent public-input replay and an independent rational price calculation agree. The changed input control is rejected. The separate docs-only selected replay navigation prerequisite is included.

## Credit and next question

Clear1nsight #7161 supplied the native word, Rohan Arun #7113 supplied the signed caller and interval arithmetic, and #7165 supplied the exact paid recount and normalized replay. Codex and subagents materially assisted. Resume at role 85, read 40874, retaining every unvisited read and unexcluded block in the directed upper. A surviving fusion still needs exact signed phase, literal ownership return and full price.
